scope: Web applications and APIs; not a full security certification.
reference_standard: OWASP ASVS-oriented verification; OWASP Top 10:2025 used for risk coverage mapping, not claimed as complete coverage.

checks.title: Object/action authorization and privileged-route enforcement
checks.next_step: Test direct object/action access across roles/tenants; UI hiding is not authorization.

checks.title: Row-level or equivalent tenant/data isolation where applicable
checks.next_step: Use synthetic cross-tenant tests; mark NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale when the data model does not require row-level isolation.

checks.title: Outbound request / SSRF controls for user-influenced destinations
checks.next_step: Review URL allowlists, DNS/IP handling, redirects, metadata/internal-network protections and egress policy.

checks.title: CORS matches intended browser trust boundaries
checks.next_step: Test allowed/disallowed origins on endpoints where browser cross-origin access matters; wildcard is not automatically a vulnerability for public unauthenticated resources.

checks.title: Relevant browser security headers configured
checks.next_step: Review CSP, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, HSTS where HTTPS is established, MIME sniffing and referrer policy as applicable.

checks.title: Production debug and sensitive error disclosure disabled
checks.next_step: Exercise representative failures and inspect production-like responses/logs.

checks.title: Cloud/object/database storage exposure reviewed
checks.next_step: Verify public/private policies, bucket/container/database grants and anonymous access.

checks.title: Dependency and build-supply-chain review
checks.next_step: Use ecosystem/SCA tooling or an approved advisory feed; the offline core cannot determine current CVEs.

checks.title: Lockfiles, registries and build artifact provenance
checks.next_step: Review lockfiles, trusted registries, CI permissions, dependency pinning and artifact integrity/signing where warranted.

checks.title: Cryptography and key-management controls
checks.next_step: Review transport security, at-rest protection where required, approved algorithms, key storage/rotation and misuse of home-grown crypto.

checks.title: Password storage and verification where passwords are handled directly
checks.next_step: If delegated to an identity provider, inspect provider controls; otherwise verify modern password hashing and parameters.

checks.title: Secrets and private credentials stay server-side and out of source
checks.next_step: Review repository, client bundles, deployment config and rotation/revocation process.

checks.title: Injection-safe command/query/template construction
checks.next_step: Review SQL/NoSQL/command/template/header/path contexts; parameterization is one control, not the whole category.

checks.title: Server-side input validation for trust-boundary inputs
checks.next_step: Validate type, range, length, format and business constraints on the server.

checks.title: Context-appropriate XSS defenses
checks.next_step: Review framework escaping, dangerous HTML sinks, sanitization and CSP/Trusted Types where appropriate.

checks.title: CSRF protections for cookie-authenticated state changes where applicable
checks.next_step: Verify SameSite strategy and anti-CSRF defenses for relevant flows; token-only non-cookie APIs may be NOT_APPLICABLE.

checks.title: Threat model / abuse-case review
checks.next_step: Document assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases, privileged operations and likely attacker paths.

checks.title: Abuse, resource and rate controls on sensitive/expensive endpoints
checks.next_step: Test bounded bursts on auth, messaging, expensive AI/search, upload and other abuse-prone operations.

checks.title: Authentication flow, brute-force and account-enumeration controls
checks.next_step: Review login, lockout/rate control, enumeration, re-authentication and provider settings.

checks.title: Session/token lifecycle and cookie protections
checks.next_step: Verify HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite where cookies are used, rotation, expiry, revocation/logout, fixation resistance and unsafe client storage.

checks.title: MFA or step-up authentication where risk warrants it
checks.next_step: Apply to privileged/high-risk actions based on threat model; otherwise document NOT_APPLICABLE.

checks.title: Account recovery and identity-change flows
checks.next_step: Test reset tokens, expiry, enumeration resistance, email/identity changes and session invalidation.

checks.title: Webhook/message authenticity and replay handling
checks.next_step: Verify signatures/authenticity, timestamp/replay handling and idempotency for inbound trusted events.

checks.title: Untrusted serialized/data artifacts are integrity-checked before privileged use
checks.next_step: Review deserialization, signed artifacts, updates, imported config/data and trust-boundary transitions.

checks.title: Secrets and unnecessary sensitive data are excluded/redacted from logs
checks.next_step: Inspect representative application, proxy and provider logs.

checks.title: Security-relevant events are logged and actionable alerts exist
checks.next_step: Verify auth/privilege/security events, retention, tamper resistance, alert routing and response ownership.

checks.title: Exceptional conditions fail safely
checks.next_step: Test malformed inputs, dependency failures, partial transactions, timeouts, retries and fail-open/fail-closed behavior.

checks.title: File upload validation and safe serving
checks.next_step: Validate type/content, size, names, storage location, malware workflow if relevant and response headers.

checks.title: Independent security review / SAST / targeted testing
checks.next_step: Record scope, tool/reviewer, date and unresolved findings; this is process evidence, not a substitute for the controls above.
